# Media Tags

## Summary
The descriptive tags on a track — title, artist, album and the rest.

## Shape
`scheme` is a `CodedValueField` over `tag-scheme` and it is load-bearing: the conventions disagree
about what a field means. An ID3v2 `TRCK` is the string `4/12` while an MP4 `trkn` atom is a pair
of integers, so `track` and `disc` are `StringField` and a consumer comparing two files needs to
know which convention it is reading. Schemes: `id3v2`, `riff-info`, `mp4-atoms`,
`vorbis-comment`, `xmp`.

## Example
```ts
import { MediaTagsField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(MediaTagsField);
```
